# Feature: Settings Spielregeln + Notizen

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Replace the Settings „Notizen“ stub (and remove „Über Letz Fetz“) with a **Spielregeln & Notizen** panel: open the existing V5 `PlayRulesModal`, and open a local-browser notes UI with create/edit/delete where each note shows DE date+time stamps.

## Preconditions

- App open (Vite + React shell)
- Settings modal reachable from header/menu
- `PlayRulesModal` / `SPIELANLEITUNG_V5_DRAFT` already wired for Play

## Happy Path

- [ ] Settings panel section titled „Spielregeln & Notizen“ (not bare „Notizen“)
- [ ] „Über Letz Fetz“ heading and Playtest-Plattform paragraph are gone
- [ ] „Spielregeln“ opens the existing rules modal (`data-testid="play-rules-modal"`)
- [ ] „Notizen“ opens notes modal (`data-testid="game-notes-modal"`) with create/edit/delete
- [ ] Each note shows created (and updated if different) timestamp in `de-DE` locale (date + time)
- [ ] Notes persist in localStorage across reload

## Edge Cases

- [ ] localStorage unavailable / quota → no crash; in-session edits still work where possible
- [ ] Empty title/content cannot create a note
- [ ] Delete asks for confirmation

## Regression

- [ ] Play toolbar „Spielregeln“ still opens the same modal content
- [ ] Other Settings sections (Audio, Anzeige, …) unchanged
- [ ] Header no longer shows a standalone „Notizen öffnen“ (existing e2e)
- [ ] `npm run build` (or checks) green

## Assumptions

- Reuse `PlayRulesModal` via App composition root (`onOpenRules`); no second rules browser
- Drop legacy API `/notes` + comments UI in shell Notes (stub never worked local-first)
- Card Forge card notes stay separate (per-card overlays)
